name: com.jrmf360.walletlib.ui.MyWalletActivity
description: The JRMF Wallet SDK opens this Activity as the wallet home page. It shows the balance and linked-card count and provides access to top-ups, withdrawals, account details, cards, transaction history, security, and red envelopes.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to open the wallet and use its account, card, balance, and transaction features.
